issues.detail: The Greek phrase 'περιπατουσιν ους' (walking as/like) is missing its object or the specific manner of 'walking'. More importantly, the Vietnamese translation omits the word 'như' (as/like) in relation to the action of walking; the Greek implies they are 'walking [as] enemies', but the Vietnamese structure makes it sound like they are living as enemies without clearly linking the 'walking' (conduct/lifestyle) to the 'enemies' status in the same way the Greek connects 'περιπατουσιν ους' with 'εχθρους'.
